node: Hyperscaler AI capex and cloud AI demand
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the universe for the AI demand/capex conversion node beyond the seed hyperscalers into five US-listed companies with direct exposure to revenue-ready AI compute capacity: Oracle as a hyperscale cloud/AI infrastructure platform, CoreWeave as an AI-native neocloud, Digital Realty and Equinix as data-center asset/platform owners, and Dell as an AI server integration and deployment beneficiary. The common chokepoint lens is whether AI capex can be converted into usable, leased, revenue-producing compute capacity rather than remaining delayed by power, land, GPU/server availability, memory/component costs, permitting, or customer concentration. Expanded the node universe toward physical AI data-center conversion bottlenecks: liquid cooling, rack-level power/cooling components, mechanical/electrical contractors, and hyperscale construction execution capacity. The candidates below are not trade recommendations; they are research candidates with plausible direct or second-order exposure to hyperscaler AI capex turning into revenue-ready capacity. Expanded the universe around the capex-to-revenue conversion bottleneck rather than only AI chips.
